sources.label: About
sources.content: I'm an independent AI product builder, vibecoder, and creative technologist based in Hong Kong. I run an independent studio called Magnolia Labs building AI-powered consumer wellness apps for Gen Z. My specialty is 3D low-poly vibecoded interfaces and B2C healthcare apps — interactive worlds where visual storytelling carries the product, built end-to-end with AI-native tooling. Everything I ship is vibecoded; I don't write code by hand. My positioning is the translator between what AI can do and how it lands on humans — a throughline that runs across journalism, UX, AI governance, and now product.

sources.label: Apps & products (with numbers)
sources.content:
stiff — Native iOS, live on the App Store under Magnolia Labs. A screen-time intervention app that uses computer vision to verify you've actually stretched before unlocking your apps. SwiftUI, native Screen Time API, on-device CV.

DreamDump — Native iOS, live on the App Store under Magnolia Labs. An AI dream journal with crisis-content safety guardrails baked in. SwiftUI + LLM backend with safety classifiers.

The Christmas Sims — Live web build. Won Most Popular at the MentorMates × BubbleLabs hackathon in Hong Kong. A 25-day interactive Advent calendar built in 2 hours. React, Three.js, Lovable.

PomoReef — Web build. Won 2nd place at Builder Night (Lonely Octopus × MindWorks Capital). Built and deployed in one hour.

Lumina (Gesture Gallery) — A contactless 3D art gallery navigated by hand gestures via MediaPipe. ~1K LinkedIn impressions. Built with two prompts in Gemini 3. MediaPipe + Three.js + React.

Portfolio V2 (karmenyip.com) — A 3D interactive Hong Kong ding-ding tram that rides between six worlds. Procedural geometry only — no Blender, no GLB imports. React Three Fiber, drei, GSAP, Howler.js. Mobile target: 60fps on iPhone Safari.

Three mobile apps shipped, two App Store live, two hackathon awards (Most Popular + 2nd place), all vibecoded.

sources.label: Work experience
sources.content:
HSBC — Graduate, CIB COO Programme, Hong Kong (July 2025 → present). AI Ambassador across both rotations. Currently GPS Operations Associate on the ASP Regional Team (Team AI Champion) — built a cross-market comparison pack for extra-large value payments using the GenAI productivity suite, analysed 160k payment query fields using AI to produce a management-ready taxonomy, productised workflows via reusable prompt files. Previously in Banking & Transformation, Portfolio Value Management — owned end-to-end adoption of Tailwind, an internal GenAI product for investment case validation, acted as PoC Owner, ran UAT, partnered with developers to iterate on prompts, drove adoption through live demos and training at CIB Portfolio Sync and CIB TnP India L&D. Shipped 4 internal reporting tools used by country COOs across 12 value streams, built 7 regional packs for FRP 2026 ASP Programmes. Co-led the DCREST Data Visa assessment for AI data use.

Varsity (CUHK) — Award-winning tech journalist covering emerging tech and AI for a general audience, including a 2022 story on Midjourney's open beta. Where the translator instinct comes from.

HSBC internship — UX/UI Designer on an internal AI risk-management platform. First exposure to designing AI products at enterprise scale.

BlueDot Impact — AI Governance Researcher. Final-year research on copyright, transparency, and authenticity in AI-generated music and virtual influencers. Where DreamDump's crisis-content guardrails came from.

Guest lecturer at CUHK. Workshop host for generative AI creative workshops.

sources.label: Origin
sources.content: Came in from journalism → UX → governance → building — four different angles on the same question of how AI lands with real people. Started as a tech journalist at Varsity (CUHK), translating complex AI into stories before the hype cycle. Pivoted into UX through an HSBC internship designing an internal AI risk-management platform. Trained in AI governance through BlueDot Impact, with research on copyright, transparency, and authenticity in AI-generated music. Now ships consumer AI products at Magnolia Labs and works at HSBC as an AI Ambassador on the CIB COO Graduate Programme. The stack is the thing — each chapter taught a specific way to translate between humans and technology.

sources.label: How I work
sources.content: Vibecode everything — Claude Code, Gemini, Lovable, v0. Ship at speed without losing intention. Safety before features, especially for B2C wellness products. Built for the worst day — apps work hardest when someone needs them most. Cultural specificity over generic. AI as co-creator, not automation layer. Privacy by default, not as an add-on — outbound data allowlists, local LLMs (Ollama), explicit network gating for personal infrastructure. Ship first, refine architecture after validating the concept. Direct and informal — say what I mean, call out when reasoning doesn't follow through. Iterative, not perfectionist. Decisive about scope — cut and defer features fast. Visual-first thinker — sketch, mock, screenshot before spec. Allergic to corporate LinkedIn voice and AI thought-leader pontificating. Build to stay sane — channeling hard moments into shipping is core to how I cope.
